speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
text: asked the Minister for Education whether the Ministry provides any subsidies and accreditation to Singapore international schools located in cities outside of Singapore.

speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
text: I am just wondering if we could get some numbers in terms of – of course, keeping in mind that these numbers are not strictly comparable due to price differences – cross-country prices.

speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
text: But is there a percentage of subsidies extended to international schools?

speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
text: And is there a distinction between such support for the school as an aggregate or is it directed specifically to reducing the fees paid by Singaporeans abroad.

speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
text: Just very quickly, is there a strategic reason why Hong Kong and not any of the other international schools?
